newsitem.title: USA: Conrail says holders voted against opt out.
newsitem.headline: Conrail says holders voted against opt out.

text.p: Conrail Inc said Thursday shareholders voted against the proposal to opt out of a Pennsylvania statute at a special meeting held January 17.

Conrail said that, out ot 77 million shares voted, 49,898,715 shares, or about 65 percent, voted against the proposal and 26,782,745 shares, or about 35 percent voted for. A small number, 313,066 abstained.

"The outcome of the shareholder meeting was not unexpected, given Norfolk Southern's last minute enticement to buy 9.9 percent of the Conrail shares," said David LeVan, Conrail's chairman and chief executive.
